Do I need a complete brief?＋No. Start with your goal, who the result is for and what is difficult today. Existing tools, target timing and a budget range are useful when you have them. Can we start small?＋Yes. A focused MVP, a single workflow or a landing page can be a useful first step. We can discuss the essential requirements before expanding the scope. How much will it cost?＋That depends on the scope, complexity, integrations and content required. We’ll discuss the work with you before agreeing on pricing. How long will the project take?＋Timing is agreed for each project. Requirements, review rounds, content readiness and third-party integrations all affect the plan. Can you work with our existing tools?＋We’ll review the current setup and available integrations first. That helps determine what can connect, what should stay and whether something needs to change. What happens after delivery?＋Handover, access, hosting responsibilities and any maintenance or further development are discussed in the project agreement.
